Construct an offline comparative-judgment decision request

Source: R/decision_prompts.R
decision_request.Rd

Internal foundation for single-trait binary decision endpoints. This helper constructs a request without HTTP, credentials, retries, persistence, or model availability checks. Existing live/batch dispatchers do not call it yet.

Usage

.build_decision_request(
  ID1,
  text1,
  ID2,
  text2,
  trait_name,
  trait_description,
  pair_uid,
  provider = c("openai", "typesafe"),
  model = NULL,
  decision_template = NULL,
  prompt_template = NULL
)

Arguments

ID1, ID2

Distinct, nonempty character scalar sample IDs, in presentation order. IDs may recur across different pairs; each scheduled occurrence must have a distinct pair_uid when results are normalized.

text1, text2

Nonmissing character scalar sample texts. Empty text is allowed. Exact characters, including whitespace and line endings, are kept.

trait_name, trait_description

Nonempty character scalars. The complete description, including construct boundaries, is inserted verbatim. Inserted content is never interpreted again as template syntax.

pair_uid

Nonempty character scalar identifying the actual scheduled pair occurrence. It is separate from any provider request ID.

provider

Either "openai" or "typesafe".

model

Requested model ID. NULL selects "gpt-6-luna" for OpenAI or pinned "jev-1.13.0" for TypeSafe. Explicit alternatives are recorded, not checked for account availability. Aliases do not guarantee immutable weights.

decision_template

NULL selects the exact approved decision_cj_v1 instructions. A custom character scalar must contain {TRAIT_NAME} and {TRAIT_DESCRIPTION} and must not embed sample placeholders or the generative <BETTER_SAMPLE> output tag. Custom text is fingerprinted.

prompt_template

Must be NULL. An explicitly supplied generative template is rejected. Future decision endpoint wrappers must distinguish omitted/defaulted generative arguments (use decision_cj_v1) from explicitly supplied generative templates (error), and forward custom instructions using decision_template. Historical set_prompt_template() behavior is unchanged.

Value

A list with body (provider wire representation), pair_uid, provenance, and request_fingerprint. The fixed question writing_trait has type choice and exactly SAMPLE_1/SAMPLE_2 options. Symmetric option descriptions differ only by sample label. Shared evidence is one JSON string with those two keys; JSON quoting gives explicit boundaries even when sample text contains labels, quotes, or newlines. OpenAI uses /v1/decisions, input and a questions/choices array; TypeSafe uses /v1/systemone, state and a questions/criteria map. Samples are never placed in instructions.

Details

The built-in instruction value is UTF-8, LF-separated, without a trailing newline; its SHA-256 is 06fdf52ff1b9b9128f7e52189053226ad1f15f4ea4a54266ea55a78399ef22af.

Fingerprint scheme decision-v1-sha256 hashes UTF-8 compact JSON, with fixed field/choice order and unboxed scalars. Provenance includes contract version, provider, endpoint, requested model, question/type, ordered IDs, SHA-256 hashes of both exact UTF-8 texts and the evidence rendering, complete trait definition, template version/text, rendered instructions, and both choice definitions. No Unicode normalization, trimming, or line-ending conversion is performed. Pair UID, provider request ID, response/resolved model, and timestamps are not scientific fingerprint inputs. Future resumption must verify both pair UID and fingerprint, and inspect resolved-model metadata when aliases are used; this helper does not implement resumption or guarantee provider reproducibility.

The body contains private sample text and must not be logged publicly. Provenance contains text hashes, not sample contents, but custom trait/template text can itself be sensitive. These model probabilities do not establish validated educational assessment accuracy. No statistical model uses them as fractional wins, weights, or additional judgments.

See also

decision_results, set_prompt_template()

Examples

# Entirely offline; this does not submit a request.
request <- pairwiseLLM:::.build_decision_request(
  "A", "A short synthetic sample.", "B", "Another synthetic sample.",
  "Organization", "Logical sequencing and connections between ideas.",
  pair_uid = "example-forward", provider = "openai"
)
request$request_fingerprint
#> [1] "decision-v1-sha256-4412231ad2743e1363c16a7a608a950af10a3080dea4bfc18620e5f3fdceea82"
request$body$questions[[1]]$type
#> [1] "choice"
